meta.name: golden-pptx
meta.description: Use when testing the pptx golden build

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证PPTX生成功能是否正常
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify PPTX generation works correctly

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以基于一份名为“The Deck”的演示文稿内容回答问题，包括概念、代码示例、表格和演讲者备注。
howto.when: 当用户询问关于 golden_pptx 演示文稿的内容，例如概念、代码示例或表格时触发。

say.text: The Deck 演示文稿的架构概览是什么？
say.note: Claude 会从演示文稿中提取架构部分的内容。

say.text: 演示文稿中有哪些 Python 代码示例？
say.note: Claude 会列出并解释演示文稿中的 Python 代码。

say.text: 演示文稿的配置表有哪些选项？
say.note: Claude 会返回表格中的选项和默认值。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can answer questions based on a presentation titled 'The Deck', including concepts, code examples, tables, and speaker notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about the content of the golden_pptx presentation, such as concepts, code examples, or tables.

say_en.text: What is the architecture overview in The Deck?
say_en.note: Claude extracts the architecture section from the presentation.

say_en.text: What Python code examples are in the presentation?
say_en.note: Claude lists and explains the Python code examples.

say_en.text: What options are in the configuration table?
say_en.note: Claude returns the table options and defaults.
